title: ro ro ke ye zainab ne kaha auno mohammad
body:
RO RO KE YEH ZAINAB NE KAHA AUN-O-MOHD
GHAR KAR GAYE VEERAN MERA AUN-O-MOHD

<<DIVIDER>>

Pehlu me jo Tum hote to Soti thi suku’n se
Neend aayegi ab kaise bhala Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Sonchi thi jawa’n honge Meri aankhon ke taro
Tifli me huwe Mujh se juda Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Kya rooth ke Maadar se khafa hogaye pyaaron
Hojaay ye Maa Tum pa fida Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Ghar Mera hamesha ke liye kar Gaye barbaad
Aabaad huwi Karbobala Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Do chaand Mere chhup gaye badli me sitam ki
Sara jaha’n andhera hua Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Ab Tum jo nahi’n ghar mujhe achha nahi’n lagta
Yaad aati hai har ik ada Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Tanhai me ghut ghut ke sada Gham me Tumhare
Karti hu’n me raaton ko buka Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Tum sahib e aulaad jo hote to samajhte
Kis dil se di marne ki riza Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Reh reh ke khayal aata hai Tum Dono se pehle 
Kyun aayi nahi’n Mujh ko qaza Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Baalo’n se chhupaati rahi chehre ko Main Apne
Chheeni gayi jab Meri rida Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Uftaad Sohail aisi thi ik Ghamzada Maa par
Thi dil ke dhadakne ki sada Aun-o-Mohd
